feature: Image Viewer plugin with plugin ID `image-viewer`, action ID `view-image`, engine `explorer-action`, and variant `default`
Explorer Action protocol v2 primary image viewing for BMP, GIF, JFIF, JPE, JPEG, JPG, PNG, and WEBP files
Fit-to-screen display with focal pinch zoom, panning, double-tap reset, and tap-to-hide controls
File name, MIME type, size, and decoded resolution metadata, plus sharing and safe external viewer fallback
Separate protected Explorer and public Android `ACTION_VIEW` gateways with temporary read-only URI access and an 8 TiB input limit
Pure JVM implementation with no native library, unrestricted ABIs declared by `supportedAbis = emptyArray()`, one ABI-independent APK, and required AutoJs6 host build 5269

Localized metadata, interface text, usage instructions, README files, and changelogs in Spanish, French, Russian, Arabic, Japanese, Korean, English, Simplified Chinese, Hong Kong Traditional Chinese, and Taiwan Traditional Chinese
